rail_guard.text: Glastonbury Station. Closed in 1966, reopened by something nobody will admit.
Hop aboard. The Wildlore rail runs to any town you have visited. Where to?

druid_lady.text: Glastonbury has been a pilgrimage place for thousands of years. Pagans, Christians, Arthurians, all queuing politely for the same hill.
I'm a druid, by the way. I have a lovely robe. It's mostly pockets.

crystal_seller.text: Rose quartz for love, amethyst for calm, and tiger's eye if you're about to run a bath for a cat.
Glastonbury has more crystal shops per street than anywhere I know. We're all friends. We're also all in competition.

steward.text: The Glastonbury Festival started in 1970 with 1,500 people and free milk. Now it's about 200,000 and a very long queue for chips.
The festival has a Green Field, a Stone Circle and a Pyramid Stage. The pyramid is the only bit that stays dry.

cider_seller.text: Somerset is cider country. We press apples from old orchards, and some of them are older than I am.
I'll pour you an apple juice. The cider can wait. You've got a Tor to climb. Gravity is not on your side.

abbey_guide.text: The Abbey was closed down in 1539 by Henry VIII, and the last abbot, Richard Whiting, was put to death on top of the Tor. A sad day for the town.
What's left are the ruins of the Lady Chapel and some very lovely grass. The grass is Grade I listed. Not literally.

chalice_gardener.text: The Chalice Well runs continuously. They say it's never failed, even in the 1976 drought.
The Red Spring is red because of iron. The White Spring is next door and runs white because of limestone. They're like a married couple.

then.text: I'm having a lie-down on a ley line. They say it does wonders for the back. I mostly feel the grass.
Go on up. And tell the Green Man I said hello. If he says anything, record it. For science. And for me.
Oh, there you are. I've been waiting by this very photogenic gate for an hour. Seven people took my picture.
You were there at the orchard, weren't you? I carried the flowers. I've never felt so useful in my life. My arms ache.
{player}! Glastonbury! I've had three cups of something herbal and I can see colours I didn't know about.
I'm not with the Enclosure any more, but I'm still going to beat you. That's just friendship.

else.text: I'm not streaming any of this. I'm just standing near a hill. It happens to be the nicest hill I've ever seen.
Morwen's at the top. Be nice to her. She's got a way with lanterns, and I want to keep my eyebrows.
